aiDescription: Adds five new pilotable variants of roider strikecraft to the Roider Union mod. These variants are designed to integrate with existing Roider Union content and use assets from the Arma Armatura mod. The mod fixes an issue where strikecraft were affecting the fleet's max burn level.
